secrets.name: The Dusk Room
secrets.text: On the line there is a door, and behind it the sun has just gone down. It will not get any darker in here. It has promised.

meta.label: Noon and Midnight
meta.blurb: At one end of the hall it is noon. At the other it is midnight, and has been for as long as anyone remembers. The line between them is brass, and nobody reads on it.
